# Nothing

Nothing applies a minimalist look drawn from the Nothing visual identity, using neutral tones, ample whitespace and subtle contrasts for a distraction-free interface. The recorded description states that the theme is a fork of an existing obsidian-nothing-theme repository.

![Nothing screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dashedman/obsidian-nothing-theme/HEAD/screenshot-0.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Nothing"
    author: "AS Sarb"
    repo:   "dashedman/obsidian-nothing-theme"
    slug:   "nothing"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/nothing"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/dashedman/obsidian-nothing-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dashedman/obsidian-nothing-theme/HEAD/screenshot-0.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a clean, minimalist aesthetic inspired by Nothing's visual identity to Obsidian. Use neutral tones, ample whitespace, and subtle contrasts to create a sleek, distraction-free interface. Fork from: https://github.com/saulojoab/obsidian-nothing-theme"
}
```
